roi.body: Sekcem ssuma talemmast n umeẓlu deg usalun-ik. Asiḍen d afessas: ssuma n uɣawas ɣef ssuma-k talemmast.

pricing.startFree: Yal amiḍan ad yebdu s uɣawas Baṭel; tzemreḍ ad tɛeddiḍ ɣer Starter neɣ Pro seg usebter n Ujerred.
pricing.payment: Axelleṣ s takarḍa CIB neɣ Edahabia (SATIM).
pricing.enterprise: Aṭas n yisalunen neɣ tuttriwin tiẓlayin? Aɣawas Tasbeddit yella s usuter.

free.q: Aɣawas Baṭel yesra takarḍa n lbanka?
free.a: Ala. Ad terneḍ amiḍan-ik s imayl d wawal uffir. Tilisa n uɣawas Baṭel (20 n tmlilin deg waggur, 10 n yimsaɣen, 5 n yimeẓla) qedrent i wakken ad tɛerḍeḍ Saloneo.

payment.a: S takarḍa CIB neɣ Edahabia, s tewwurt taɣellsant SATIM, seg usebter n Ujerred n umiḍan-ik.

change.a: Ih. Tzemreḍ ad tɛeddiḍ ɣer uɣawas yugaren melmi i tebɣiḍ, seg usebter n Ujerred. Timlilin-ik, imsaɣen-ik d yimeẓla-k ad qqimen.

limit.q: D acu ara yeḍrun ma wwḍeɣ ɣer tilist?
limit.a: Saloneo ad k-id-yelɣu. Isefka-k ad qqimen akken llan; i wakken ad ternuḍ wiyaḍ, ɛeddi kan ɣer uɣawas yugaren.

yearly.a: Ad txelleṣeḍ tnac n wagguren yiwet n tikkelt, ad txelleṣeḍ {{discount}} % ddaw n uxelleṣ s waggur. Llan daɣen snat d kraḍ n yiseggasen, s usenqes ameqqran.

data.q: Anwa i izemren ad iwali isefka n usalun-iw?
data.a: Kečč d yimdanen n terbaɛt-ik. Amyeɣbar gar yibenk-ik d Saloneo yettwawgelhen (HTTPS).

founder.title: Saloneo yebda, s yisalunen imezwura
founder.body: Ur tettafeḍ dagi ara timawin tikerkas neɣ izwilen yettwasimɣuren: Saloneo akken kan i yeldi, nesmenyaf ad ak-d-nesken afaris akken yella.
founder.body2: Ma tebɣiḍ tallalt i usbeddi n usalun-ik — imeẓla, tarbaɛt, asebter n uḥeǧǧez — aru-yaɣ-d. D tarbaɛt i yesbennun Saloneo ara k-d-yerren.

cta.title: Asalun-ik yezmer ad yeṭṭef timlilin-is timezwura srid seg wass-a.
cta.body: Rnu amiḍan-ik, rnu imeẓla-k, bḍu aseɣwen-ik.
